marketLayer.title: US Big Tech & Semiconductors
marketLayer.fact: Major US tech hyper-scalers report continued capital expenditure expansion into AI infrastructure, while software revenue monetization demonstrates a mixed pace across recent earnings disclosures.
marketLayer.inference: Semiconductor equipment and chip designers maintain solid order visibility, though broader megacap valuations remain vulnerable to pullbacks if cloud providers fail to show immediate AI-driven margin expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustainability of hyper-scaler AI capital spending trajectories amid energy grid capacity constraints and elevated interest rate environments.

marketLayer.title: Hong Kong Tech & Southbound Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index showed resilience driven by strong daily net inflows via Southbound Stock Connect, prioritizing platform internet giants and consumer hardware leaders.
marketLayer.inference: Mainland institutional capital is providing a supportive floor for HK-listed tech valuations, offsetting persistent offshore macro headwinds and foreign exchange fluctuations.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Quarterly earnings delivery capabilities among key platform internet stocks and shifts in global risk sentiment affecting broader Hong Kong liquidity.

marketLayer.title: Chinese EVs & Clean Energy
marketLayer.fact: Leading Chinese EV producers announced accelerated global market penetration strategies targeting South America and Southeast Asia alongside stabilizing domestic retail pricing.
marketLayer.inference: Overseas volume expansion offers a path to offset domestic margin pressure, benefiting established players with scale benefits and vertical integration in battery supply chains.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential regulatory shifts, foreign tariffs, and local content requirements in key export markets.
